children: REPORTS EMISSIONS FROM 117 DOCK LINE ON SEPT 14 AT BAYTOWN, TEXAS REFINERY
REPORTS 117 DOCK LINE EXPERIENCED AN UNANTICIPATED LEAK RESULTING IN MINOR SPILL TO REFINERY DOCKS BERTH IN HOUSTON SHIP CHANNEL AND POTENTIAL EMISSIONS TO ATMOSPHERE AT BAYTOWN REFINERY
REPORTS BOOMS WERE PROMPTLY DEPLOYED TO CONTAIN MATERIAL WITHIN DOCKS BERTH, OPERATIONAL ADJUSTMENTS MADE TO ISOLATE LEAK AND MINIMIZE EMISSIONS
REPORTS THE EVENT HAS ENDED AND AS OF THE TIME OF THE REPORT, THERE IS NO FORESEEABLE ADVERSE IMPACT TO PERSONNEL, THE COMMUNITY, OR PRODUCTION
